parameters.text:
=You are a CV parser. Read the CV below and produce a structured profile.

Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown fences, no commentary. Exactly this shape:
{
  "headline": "one line describing this person professionally",
  "seniority": "junior | mid | senior",
  "core_skills": ["skills they are genuinely strong in"],
  "secondary_skills": ["skills they have touched but are not specialists in"],
  "domains": ["industries or problem areas they have worked in"],
  "notable_projects": [
    {"name": "project name as written on the CV",
     "what": "one line on what it did",
     "tech": ["technologies used"],
     "result": "the measurable outcome if the CV states one, else null"}
  ],
  "not_suited_to": ["kinds of work this person should NOT be matched with"]
}

notable_projects is the most important field: the pitch step can only cite work
it can see here. Include every distinct project, tool or system on the CV.

Only list what actually appears in the CV. Do not infer or invent.

CV TEXT:
{{ $json.text }}

=You are matching freelance projects to one specific freelancer.

FREELANCER PROFILE:
{{ $('Parse Profile').first().json.profile_json }}

PROJECTS TO SCORE (JSON array):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.jobs.map(j => ({job_id: j.job_id, title: j.title, skills: j.skills, budget_max: j.budget_max, currency: j.currency}))) }}

For EVERY project in the array, score 0-100 for how well it fits this freelancer,
plus one short sentence of reasoning.

Scoring rules:
- 80-100: squarely in their core skills
- 50-79: adjacent, they could do it with some stretch
- 20-49: weak overlap
- 0-19: wrong field entirely
Be honest and be willing to score low. A project needing skills this freelancer
does not have MUST score below 20. Never credit them with skills absent from the
profile.

Return ONLY a valid JSON array, no markdown fences, one object per project:
[{"job_id": "...", "score": 0, "reason": "..."}]

=Write a short application pitch for each freelance project below, in the freelancer's own voice.

FREELANCER PROFILE (including notable_projects):
{{ $('Parse Profile').first().json.profile_json }}

TOP PROJECTS:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.top) }}

For each project, 2-3 SHORT sentences that:
- open with the specific relevant experience for THAT project
- CITE ONE SPECIFIC PROJECT BY NAME from notable_projects, and say what it did
- state concretely what you would do first on this job
- no greetings, no sign-offs

Every pitch MUST name a real project from notable_projects. A pitch that cites
no specific past work is a failed pitch - pick the closest one and say why it is
relevant.

BANNED phrasing, do not use in any form:
"deliver a high-quality solution", "meets your requirements", "I am excited",
"passionate", "extensive experience", "proven track record".

Never invent experience the profile does not contain.

Keep every pitch under 400 characters. Return ONLY a valid JSON array, no
markdown fences, no trailing commentary:
[{"job_id": "...", "pitch": "..."}]
